اشتعلتا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلَتَا (ištaʕalatā) /iʃ.ta.ʕa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلَتَا (uštuʕilatā) /uʃ.tu.ʕi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
